headline: 6 Months
caption:
UPDATE: Usman Nurmagomedov has reportedly been sentenced to six months in prison over the Abu Dhabi hotel attack on Merab Dvalishvili.
CBS Sports, citing Abu Dhabi's judicial department, reports Usman and five others were also fined and will be deported after serving. RAF says Merab has been released from custody and is back with the team ahead of Saturday's RAF Abu Dhabi event.

Hoping everyone involved can move forward safely.

serious.title: Usman Nurmagomedov sentenced to six months
facts: Reported sentence: six months in prison in Abu Dhabi
Usman and five others reportedly fined and to be deported
RAF says Merab Dvalishvili is out of custody
Merab's match with Marlon Moraes not yet confirmed
serious.closing: Hoping everyone involved can move forward safely.
